name: Google Ads - CINNA Customer Match List

parameters.query:
WITH KundenDaten AS
(
    SELECT
        a.cMail AS EmailAdresse,
        a.cVorname AS Vorname,
        a.cName AS Nachname,
        a.cLand AS Land,
        a.cPLZ AS Postleitzahl,
        a.cTel AS Telefonnummer,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY a.cMail
            ORDER BY a.cTel
        ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.tBestellung AS b
    INNER JOIN dbo.tAdresse AS a
        ON a.kKunde = b.tKunde_kKunde
    WHERE b.tKunde_kKunde IS NOT NULL
      AND b.cBestellNr LIKE 'CINNA%'
      AND a.cMail IS NOT NULL
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(a.cMail)) <> ''
)
SELECT
    EmailAdresse,
    Vorname,
    Nachname,
    Land,
    Postleitzahl,
    Telefonnummer
FROM KundenDaten
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY
    EmailAdresse;
